capabilities: Design sheet layouts on a grid from twelve component types
Define per-layout formulas, functions and typed modifiers
Store characters as markdown notes bound to a layout
Edit layouts in a dedicated pane with import, export and undo
Promote field values into frontmatter for Bases and Dataview queries
disambiguation: Not a ready-made D&D character sheet; it is a builder for designing your own sheets for any RPG system.
extras: Warns that the plugin rewrites note bodies and recommends testing in a new vault; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; older .json layout files are converted to .sheetsmith files.
motivation: The author found that every existing option failed on at least one of three axes and nothing combined a layout builder with a formula engine while staying system-agnostic.
problem: Existing options are static templates, system-specific renderers, or YAML-heavy flexible tools; none combines a layout builder with a formula engine and works system-agnostically.

relations.evidence: Promoted fields mirror chosen values into a character's frontmatter, so Bases and Dataview can query them.
Layout files show in the file explorer and in Notebook Navigator

summary: Character sheet builder for any tabletop RPG: design grid layouts with formulas and store each character as a plain markdown note.
